decisions.reason: As a multi-model desk system tightly linked to the firm's announced move toward flexible workplace interiors, it carries substantial development and signaling investment that management is likely to defend.
The chair family is close to the core offer and fits the firm's premium interior positioning, so earlier investment and public commitment make withdrawal relatively unlikely.

Although more peripheral than core furniture, this multi-model line still builds on the firm's materials and interior concept, which encourages management to continue rather than admit a failed extension.
A soft upholstered sofa is well within the firm's established competence and showroom logic, so management can justify keeping it while attributing any weaker results to temporary market factors.
The high standing table supports contemporary flexible work and meeting settings, matching the firm's stated direction and making discontinuation less likely after visible launch efforts.

The rug collection is the most distant from the established offer and therefore most vulnerable, but the firm has publicly presented it as a broader interior solution and is still likely to persist for now.
